contracts.signal: CoreWeave's Partner Network release lists VAST Data among its Infrastructure partners (hardware and systems partners covering GPUs, storage, networking, servers and interconnects), whose integrations are validated on CoreWeave Cloud under production conditions. VAST Data CTO Alon Horev (in the release): 'CoreWeave and VAST have been building AI infrastructure together for years, through several generations of GPUs', combining CoreWeave's AI cloud with the VAST AI Operating System.
